subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage-accounting architecture, prefer the narrower fork identity and cache repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118, or keep lineage shadow-only for now?
rationale: The alternatives establish materially different permanent accounting and cache designs, and tests cannot decide which maintenance and rollout strategy the repository should own.

options.title: Adopt lineage stack
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order after exact-head runtime proof confirms upgrade safety.

options.title: Prefer narrow repair
options.body: Land or refine https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and close the broader stack if its smaller identity and cache-dependency fix sufficiently resolves the canonical issue.

options.title: Keep shadow-only
options.body: Allow lineage infrastructure only as non-authoritative diagnostics until later evidence supports a promotion decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order after exact-head runtime proof confirms upgrade safety.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available owner for choosing the permanent scanner architecture and rollout boundary.
